The mechanisms orchestrating these changes are not well… 15491404 rapid-and-persistent-modulation-of-actin-dynamics-regulates-postsynaptic-reorganization-underlying-bidirectional-plasticity rapid persistent modulation actin dynamics regulates postsynaptic reorganization The synapse is a highly organized cellular specialization whose structure an Rapid and persistent modulation of actin dynamics regulates postsynaptic reorganization underlying bidirectional plasticity The synapse is a highly organized cellular specialization whose structure and composition are reorganized, both positively and negatively, depending on the strength of input signals. The mechanisms orchestrating these changes are not well understood. A plausible locus for the reorganization of synapse components and structure is actin, because it serves as both cytoskeleton and scaffold for synapses and exists in a dynamic equilibrium between F-actin and G-actin that is modulated bidirectionally by cellular signaling.
